Join and media connection, including listen-only
Platform: DB, releases, flags, Cloudflare edge

fields.name: acked_bps
fields.doc: The acked bitrate the estimator saw.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: The outbound encoding is active.

fields.name: admission_request_id
fields.doc: The admission request.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.doc: The tenant's identifier for the agent.

fields.name: app_build
fields.doc: The host app's build number.

fields.name: app_version
fields.doc: The host app's version.

fields.name: attempt
fields.doc: Which run of a job or which try of an op this is, starting at 1.

fields.name: banner_kind
fields.doc: Which self-test banner.

fields.name: batch_id
fields.doc: The batch that delivered the record. Stamped by the batcher or the ingest, not by the kernel.

fields.name: bitrate_bps
fields.doc: Instantaneous bitrate for the track window.

fields.name: bytes
fields.doc: Cumulative payload bytes.

fields.name: bytes_sent
fields.doc: Cumulative bytes the sender handed to the transport for a video layer.

fields.name: camera_bound
fields.doc: The camera publication is neither null nor "initial".

fields.name: capture_error_name
fields.doc: The DOMException name of a camera capture failure; the message is never emitted.

fields.name: cause
fields.doc: Why a lease or session closed.

fields.name: client_mono_ms
fields.doc: The client's monotonic clock, since its time origin.

fields.name: client_session_id
fields.doc: The SDK client session: one client object's lifetime. The client kernel stamps it on every record, separate from source_id, because one client session opens a new source for each Participant it joins as.

fields.name: client_wall_ms
fields.doc: The client's wall clock, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: clock_epoch
fields.doc: Counts clock jumps in this source. Records from different epochs are ordered only by seq.

fields.name: clock_err_ms
fields.doc: The bound on est_server_ms's error. Absent on server records.

fields.name: clock_state
fields.doc: Whether est_server_ms can be trusted.

fields.name: connection_type
fields.doc: The transport the candidate pair uses.

fields.name: covered
fields.doc: An elementFromPoint at the tile's center found a cover.

fields.name: decision
fields.doc: What a decision decided, from the event's declared values.

fields.name: decision_id
fields.doc: The decision.

fields.name: decrease_acked_bps
fields.doc: The acked bitrate at the last fall.

fields.name: decrease_ago_ms
fields.doc: How long ago the estimate last fell.

fields.name: decrease_cause
fields.doc: Why the estimate last fell.

fields.name: decrease_from_bps
fields.doc: The estimate before the last fall.

fields.name: decrease_to_bps
fields.doc: The estimate after the last fall.

fields.name: delivered_share
fields.doc: Delivered share of the subscription's packets in the congestion window.

fields.name: device_ephemeral
fields.doc: True when device_id could not be stored and lives only for this client session.

fields.name: device_id
fields.doc: The persistent device.

fields.name: device_kind
fields.doc: The device kind a device_failed row names.

fields.name: device_state
fields.doc: The media_state detail.

fields.name: drop_reason
fields.doc: On a drop record (C3): why the client gave up on the seqs in dropped_seqs.

fields.name: dropped
fields.doc: Cumulative packets the SFU dropped for congestion.

fields.name: dropped_seqs
fields.doc: On a drop record (C3): the half-open seq ranges [from, to) of the record's own source that the client gave up on, all below the record's seq, at most 64.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.doc: An op's duration, or how long a state lasted.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: The media intent bit.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: How a source ended (C3), on the batch that reports it: closed (the client said its last next_seq exactly) or abandoned (the next page load found it dead and reports the last high-water mark it persisted). The ledger refuses an end below a seq it settled or below a next_seq already reported, so the missing suffix stays a gap.

fields.name: end_reason
fields.doc: Why a call or an Episode ended. The server and the client use different values, so each event narrows the list.

fields.name: env
fields.doc: The environment.

fields.name: episode_id
fields.doc: The Episode.

fields.name: est_server_ms
fields.doc: The estimated server time in Unix milliseconds. A server stamps its own clock.

fields.name: estimate_bps
fields.doc: The congestion estimator's output for the transport.

fields.name: event_id
fields.doc: One record. Minted by the kernel when the record is made.

fields.name: feedback_age_ms
fields.doc: Age of the newest congestion feedback.

fields.name: final
fields.doc: The last row for this subscription or publication before it closed.

fields.name: fir_received
fields.doc: Cumulative FIRs the viewer's downlink received.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: The full flags map: config switches, the media-plane kill switch and caps. Never credentials.

fields.name: flags_hash
fields.doc: 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the canonical flags JSON. Resolve it with the obs.flags_snapshot fact that carries the same hash.

fields.name: forwarded_keyframes
fields.doc: Cumulative keyframes the SFU forwarded on this subscription.

fields.name: forwarded_packets
fields.doc: Cumulative video packets the SFU forwarded on this subscription.

fields.name: frame_height
fields.doc: Frame height in px for the track or layer.

fields.name: frames_decoded
fields.doc: Cumulative frames the viewer's decoder produced.

fields.name: frames_dropped
fields.doc: Cumulative frames the decoder dropped.

fields.name: frames_encoded
fields.doc: Cumulative frames the sender's encoder produced for a layer.

fields.name: frames_received
fields.doc: Cumulative frames the viewer's decoder input saw.

fields.name: freeze_count
fields.doc: Cumulative frame freezes the decoder reported.

fields.name: freeze_ms
fields.doc: Cumulative frozen milliseconds the decoder reported.

fields.name: from_state
fields.doc: The state before a transition.

fields.name: gap
fields.doc: The cause the window measured nothing (offline, hidden, or another); the row is not a zero.

fields.name: gap_ms
fields.doc: How much of the window was a gap.

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: Which join of the Participant seat this is.

fields.name: held
fields.doc: 1 while the SFU holds a publication pending unmute.

fields.name: high_layer
fields.doc: Cumulative packets forwarded at high layer.

fields.name: host_pressure
fields.doc: 1 while the host's own load biases the estimate.

fields.name: ingress_bitrate_bps
fields.doc: Ingress bitrate for the publication.

fields.name: ingress_jitter_ms
fields.doc: Ingress jitter for the publication.

fields.name: ingress_layers_active
fields.doc: Ingress layers active for the publication.

fields.name: ingress_lost
fields.doc: Cumulative ingress lost packets for the publication.

fields.name: ingress_packets
fields.doc: Cumulative ingress packets for the publication this subscription forwards, copied onto the viewer's row.

fields.name: ingress_repaired
fields.doc: Cumulative ingress repaired packets for the publication.

fields.name: item_count
fields.doc: How many items a self-test op handled.

fields.name: jitter_ms
fields.doc: Interarrival jitter in milliseconds.

fields.name: job_id
fields.doc: The background job.

fields.name: journey_id
fields.doc: The user-visible attempt this record belongs to.

fields.name: jump_ms
fields.doc: How far the wall clock stepped against the monotonic clock.

fields.name: key_frames_decoded
fields.doc: Cumulative keyframes the viewer decoded.

fields.name: keyframe_repairs
fields.doc: Cumulative ingress keyframe repairs.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: op, transition, decision, surface or fact.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: The forwarded simulcast layer.

fields.name: layers
fields.doc: How many simulcast layers the ingress carries.

fields.name: layers_active
fields.doc: How many ingress layers grew this window.

fields.name: local
fields.doc: The probed tile renders the local camera.

fields.name: local_candidate_type
fields.doc: The local ICE candidate type.

fields.name: loss_share
fields.doc: Lost share of egress packets in the window.

fields.name: lossy
fields.doc: 1 while the estimator considers the link lossy.

fields.name: lost
fields.doc: Cumulative lost packets reported for a track.

fields.name: low_layer
fields.doc: Cumulative packets forwarded at low layer.

fields.name: luma_mean
fields.doc: Mean luma of a downscaled draw of the frame, 0-255.

fields.name: machine
fields.doc: A transition's machine.

fields.name: media_connection_id
fields.doc: Chalk's media connection.

fields.name: media_kind
fields.doc: The media kind of an SFU row.

fields.name: media_state_code
fields.doc: The media_state error code.

fields.name: mid
fields.doc: The RTP mid of the camera track on a viewer's connection.

fields.name: module
fields.doc: The emitting program.

fields.name: muted
fields.doc: The camera track's muted flag.

fields.name: nack_received
fields.doc: Cumulative NACKs the viewer's downlink received.

fields.name: nack_requested
fields.doc: Cumulative NACKs the SFU asked the publisher for on ingress.

fields.name: nack_sent
fields.doc: Cumulative NACKs sent for a track.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The registry event name. A transition's name is its machine.

fields.name: next_seq
fields.doc: The source's high-water mark on every batch (C3): every seq below it has been assigned.

fields.name: note_kind
fields.doc: Which self-test note.

fields.name: on_screen
fields.doc: The IntersectionObserver reported the tile intersecting.

fields.name: op_id
fields.doc: The op.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.doc: The live request the intent joins.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: An op's terminal outcome.

fields.name: packets
fields.doc: Cumulative packets on a track (sender encoded, viewer received, SFU ingress or forwarded).

fields.name: page_visible
fields.doc: document.visibilityState was visible at probe time.

fields.name: parent_op_id
fields.doc: The op that started this one.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.doc: The Participant seat in the Episode.

fields.name: pause_reason
fields.doc: The active pause on the subscription at row time; absent when forwarding.

fields.name: paused_subscriptions
fields.doc: How many subscriptions were paused in the egress window.

fields.name: permission_after
fields.doc: Permission state measured after the capture attempt; omitted when unavailable.

fields.name: permission_before
fields.doc: Permission state measured before the capture attempt; omitted when unavailable.

fields.name: permission_probe
fields.doc: Why a permission field is absent.

fields.name: permission_state
fields.doc: Permission state a legacy row carried.

fields.name: plan
fields.doc: The SFU's camera plan level for this subscription.

fields.name: platform
fields.doc: Where the program runs.

fields.name: playout
fields.doc: The audio playout state; video tracks carry not_applicable.

fields.name: pli_received
fields.doc: Cumulative PLIs the viewer's downlink asked for.

fields.name: pli_sent
fields.doc: Cumulative PLIs sent for a track.

fields.name: policy_allows
fields.doc: document.featurePolicy.allowsFeature("camera"); omitted when unavailable.

fields.name: policy_probe
fields.doc: Why policy_allows is absent.

fields.name: presented_frames
fields.doc: requestVideoFrameCallback cumulative frame counter for a tile.

fields.name: probe_unavailable
fields.doc: The probe platform cannot supply a field; the unavailable fields are absent.

fields.name: probing
fields.doc: 1 while the transport is probing.

fields.name: proven_bps
fields.doc: The highest estimate the transport has proven.

fields.name: provider_media_id
fields.doc: The media provider's session id.

fields.name: publication_id
fields.doc: The camera publication the row is about.

fields.name: publisher_id
fields.doc: The publishing participant a viewer-bound subscription row names.

fields.name: quality_limitation_reason
fields.doc: Why the encoder is not meeting the requested resolution.

fields.name: queued_bytes
fields.doc: Bytes queued on the transport.

fields.name: ready_state
fields.doc: The video element's readyState at probe time.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why a subscription stopped or is paused; the SFU's literal reason field.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.doc: A registry reason code. Required when the outcome is expected or error, and on a decision that refuses, times out, closes or limits.

fields.name: recording_id
fields.doc: The recording.

fields.name: rect_h
fields.doc: The tile's on-screen height in CSS px.

fields.name: rect_w
fields.doc: The tile's on-screen width in CSS px.

fields.name: recv_bitrate_bps
fields.doc: Received video bitrate in bps (the row's kbps value is not read).

fields.name: recv_height
fields.doc: Received video frame height.

fields.name: recv_hidden_videos
fields.doc: How many inbound video tracks were paused because the viewer hid them.

fields.name: recv_jitter_ms
fields.doc: Inbound jitter in milliseconds.

fields.name: recv_loss_pct
fields.doc: Inbound loss share in percent.

fields.name: recv_paused_videos
fields.doc: How many inbound video tracks the viewer asked paused.

fields.name: relay_protocol
fields.doc: The relay protocol in use.

fields.name: release_sha
fields.doc: The git commit the program was built from.

fields.name: remote_candidate_type
fields.doc: The remote ICE candidate type.

fields.name: repaired
fields.doc: Cumulative packets repaired by NACK.

fields.name: repairs_cut
fields.doc: Cumulative repairs cut for congestion.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: The request attempt.

fields.name: requested_layer
fields.doc: The layer the viewer's selection asked for.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: The source lease revision ordering.

fields.name: rid
fields.doc: Simulcast rid of an outbound encoded layer; empty when there is one layer.

fields.name: rtt_ms
fields.doc: Round-trip time for the candidate pair.

fields.name: schema_ver
fields.doc: The registry's content hash, so a reader knows which catalogue the record was written against.

fields.name: sdk_version
fields.doc: The Chalk SDK version inside the host app.

fields.name: send_bitrate_bps
fields.doc: Sent video bitrate in bps (the row's kbps value is not read).

fields.name: send_jitter_ms
fields.doc: Outbound jitter in milliseconds.

fields.name: send_layer
fields.doc: The highest layer the sender is encoding.

fields.name: send_loss_pct
fields.doc: Outbound loss share in percent.

fields.name: sent_audio
fields.doc: Cumulative audio packets sent.

fields.name: sent_probe
fields.doc: Cumulative probe packets sent.

fields.name: sent_repair
fields.doc: Cumulative repair packets sent.

fields.name: sent_video
fields.doc: Cumulative video packets sent.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: The record's position in its source's stream, with no reuse. On a client the outbox stamps it, never the kernel. A client source counts from 0, as the outbox and the delivery ledger do (C3); a server source (the API, SFU and Sync kernels) counts from 1 and has no ledger.

fields.name: shown_ms
fields.doc: How long a dismissed surface was on screen.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: The media source; video checks read camera only.

fields.name: source_id
fields.doc: The stream that owns seq. On a client the outbox stamps it with seq. A client starts a new source for each page load and for each Participant it joins as, and only that Participant's credential may write it (C3); a server uses its instance id.

fields.name: space_id
fields.doc: The Space.

fields.name: span_id
fields.doc: The W3C span.

fields.name: status_shown
fields.doc: The VideoTrackStatus indicator is on screen.

fields.name: subscriptions
fields.doc: How many subscriptions the egress row covered.

fields.name: surface_state
fields.doc: Whether a surface was shown or dismissed.

fields.name: sync_connection_id
fields.doc: The Sync websocket.

fields.name: target_layer
fields.doc: The layer the SFU is trying to forward, or none when paused.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.doc: The tenant.

fields.name: tile_reason
fields.doc: The VideoTrackStatus a degraded tile names.

fields.name: tile_state
fields.doc: The rendered state the tile surface is in.

fields.name: to_state
fields.doc: The state after a transition.

fields.name: trace_id
fields.doc: The W3C trace.

fields.name: trend
fields.doc: The congestion trend the estimator reported.

fields.name: trigger
fields.doc: What caused a transition, from the machine's trigger list.

fields.name: user_id
fields.doc: The tenant's identifier for the person.

fields.name: video_height
fields.doc: videoHeight of the element at probe time.

fields.name: video_width
fields.doc: videoWidth of the element at probe time.

fields.name: was
fields.doc: The pause a resume replaced.

fields.name: webhook_delivery_id
fields.doc: The webhook delivery.

fields.name: window_ms
fields.doc: How long the stats window measured.

reasons.doc: The caller cancelled the operation before it finished.
The Episode reached its time limit and the API ended it. The client failures the end itself caused are expected.
A self-test error.
A self-test expected outcome.
An error that no classifier named. Counted as unexplained, so a rise is a gap in the catalogue.
The app was backgrounded; the picture returned when it came back.
A join.leave or end.episode near the stop.
A NotAllowedError the refusal conditions did not cover: a system block, a policy refusal, or no probe to attribute it.
The camera device is busy.
The capture constraint is invalid for this device.
No camera device.
A capture failure not named by another code.
The SFU paused the subscription for congestion.
The SFU paused the subscription because the source was inactive.
The SFU paused the subscription because the source's lease was lost.
The SFU paused the subscription because the viewer asked.
The Participant refused the camera prompt: permission_after=denied, and the denial is their choice, not a system block.
A reconnect or recovery stretch the picture matched within 10 s of the matching reconnected transition.
The browser cannot capture.
The viewer's tile was off-screen, the page hidden, or the tile covered.

events.name: client.call_ended
events.doc: The SDK decided which end screen the call gets. The client kernel records it where the connection chooses the end screen, and the API logs it as a kernel row. An SDK release before the client kernel sent it as an sdk.telemetry row of type call_ended, which the legacy match still reads.

events.name: obs.clock_jump
events.doc: The client's wall clock stepped, so its clock samples were dropped and clock_epoch moved on.

events.name: obs.flags_snapshot
events.doc: The full flags map behind the flags_hash the kernel stamps on this and every later record. Logged at boot, at join and whenever the flags change.

events.name: selftest.admit
events.doc: A self-test decision.

events.name: selftest.banner
events.doc: A self-test surface.

events.name: selftest.note
events.doc: A self-test fact.

events.name: selftest.work
events.doc: A self-test op.

events.name: sfu.media.egress
events.doc: Cumulative egress counters per viewer's downlink, one row per media kind.

events.name: sfu.media.ingress
events.doc: Cumulative ingress counters for one publication. Rows land while counters grow and once when they stop; a final row is preserved on close. Packet growth ≥50 over ≤35 s between rows means flowing.

events.name: sfu.media.transport
events.doc: Cumulative transport counters for one session; never proves a node's liveness.

events.name: sfu.publication.started
events.doc: The SFU registered a publication from a publisher.

events.name: sfu.source.lease_lost
events.doc: The publisher's source lease closed; a later lease_opened for the same source lifts the exclusion.

events.name: sfu.source.lease_opened
events.doc: The publisher's source lease opened; revision orders it.

events.name: sfu.subscription.congestion
events.doc: The congestion controller's view of a subscription: estimate, proven, delivered share, host pressure, loss share, trend.

events.name: sfu.subscription.paused
events.doc: The SFU paused a subscription.

events.name: sfu.subscription.resumed
events.doc: The SFU resumed a paused subscription; was names the replaced pause.

events.name: sfu.subscription.started
events.doc: A viewer's subscription to a publication opened.

events.name: sfu.subscription.stopped
events.doc: A subscription closed; pause_cause names why.

events.name: sync.episode.ended
events.doc: Sync saw the Episode's authoritative end, with the reason the API stored in episodes.end_reason.

events.name: sync.media.intent
events.doc: The Sync-stamped media intent the client's media_intent shares; operation_id joins it to the SFU's sfu.publication.held.

events.name: video.call_stats
events.doc: A legacy sdk.telemetry call_stats window: one 10 s sample. A window with gap measured nothing and is not a zero.

events.name: video.camera_capture
events.doc: One camera capture attempt. Ends ok or error(video.*) with the DOMException name and permission/policy probes; expected(video.permission_denied) only when the probe shows the person refused.

events.name: video.camera_track_muted
events.doc: The camera track's mute bit changed.

events.name: video.device_failed
events.doc: A legacy sdk.telemetry device_failed row.

events.name: video.media_state
events.doc: A legacy sdk.telemetry media_state row; code=media_capture_failed marks a camera-effects path failure.

events.name: video.render_probe
events.doc: A rendered-tile measurement every 2 s while a camera tile is up: presented frames, geometry, luma, visibility. On React Native the fields the platform cannot supply are absent and probe_unavailable names why.

events.name: video.send_window
events.doc: One outbound camera layer's stats for a window: frames encoded, bytes, height, quality reason, active bit.

events.name: video.stats_failed
events.doc: A stats collection failed; error_name names the DOMException kind.

events.name: video.subscription_forwarded
events.doc: Cumulative forwarded counters for one camera subscription, plus the publication's ingress counters copied onto the viewer's row so a viewer check can see upstream without reading another seat's facts. Rows land while counters grow and once when they stop; a final row is preserved on close.

events.name: video.subscription_select
events.doc: The SFU's subscription decision for a camera publication: paused (with reason) or forwarding (with target_layer).

events.name: video.tile
events.doc: The tile's rendered state: picture, avatar, paused_for_network, frozen_frame, media_state.

events.name: video.track_window
events.doc: One inbound camera track's stats for a window: cumulative packet/frame counters keyed by mid and publication.

machines.name: client.connection
machines.doc: The SDK connection state (CONNECTION_STATES in sdks/typescript/client/src/connection/types.ts). Its one writer is transition() in connection/lifecycle.ts.

machines.name: episode.lifecycle
machines.doc: The Episode row's status in Postgres (episodes.status).

machines.name: video.camera
machines.doc: The camera state machine in the space media controller. camera_bound is true while a real publication is bound.

facts.name: admission.decision
facts.doc: The API's admission decision for a join attempt. Claim: admitted, or the refusal reason.

facts.name: audio.capture
facts.doc: A rollup of a seat's microphone level before WebRTC over exactly its window. Values: rms_max_dbfs.

facts.name: audio.ingress
facts.doc: A rollup of a seat's audio packets at SFU ingress over exactly its window. Values: packets, voiced.

facts.name: audio.mic_state
facts.doc: Whether a seat's microphone was muted or unmuted, held over a window. Claim: muted or unmuted.

facts.name: board.camera
facts.doc: One move of a viewer's board camera. Claim: what moved it (user_pan, follow, fit and so on).

facts.name: end.client_screen
facts.doc: The end screen a client chose for its call. Claim: the client's end reason. A failure screen (connection lost, join failed) is a failure some finding must explain.

facts.name: end.episode
facts.doc: The Episode's authoritative end. Claim: the end reason.

facts.name: join.leave
facts.doc: A seat's leave request and its outcome. A failed leave is a failure every finding must account for.

facts.name: recording.job_state
facts.doc: The terminal state of a post-call job, read from its Postgres row. Claim: succeeded or the failure state.

facts.name: report.problem
facts.doc: A problem report a person filed, from a seat or from outside the call. Claim: the report kind.

facts.name: video.call_window
facts.doc: One call_stats 10 s window for a seat. A row with gap is a non-measurement, never a zero. Claim: window_ms.

facts.name: video.camera_capture
facts.doc: The capture op's terminal outcome for a seat; only outcome=error is a failure. Claim: outcome.

facts.name: video.camera_effects
facts.doc: A camera-effects path failure; only code=media_capture_failed counts. Claim: media_state_code.

facts.name: video.camera_state
facts.doc: The camera machine's transition rows for a seat. Claim: to_state.

facts.name: video.camera_track_muted
facts.doc: The camera track's mute bit for a seat. Claim: muted.

facts.name: video.capture_intent
facts.doc: The Sync-stamped media intent for the seat's camera source. Claim: enabled.

facts.name: video.congestion
facts.doc: The congestion controller's per-subscription view on a seat's downlink. Claim: reason.

facts.name: video.connection
facts.doc: Slice 2's client.connection transitions for a seat, read for the reconnect clause and the connected precondition. Claim: to_state.

facts.name: video.device_failure
facts.doc: A legacy device_failed row; only device_kind=camera is a failure for video. Claim: device_kind.

facts.name: video.egress
facts.doc: Cumulative SFU egress counters for a seat's downlink. Claim: media_kind.

facts.name: video.episode_ended
facts.doc: The Episode's authoritative end; near a stop it makes a finding expected. Claim: end_reason.

facts.name: video.forwarded
facts.doc: Cumulative forwarded counters for a viewer-bound camera subscription, with the publication's ingress counters copied on. Flowing means forwarded_packets growth ≥50 over ≤35 s. Claim: forwarded_packets.

facts.name: video.ingress
facts.doc: Cumulative SFU ingress counters for a seat's camera publication. Flowing means packets growth ≥50 over ≤35 s; not flowing means growth below 50 or first-row packets=0 followed by no flowing row for 20 s. Claim: packets.

facts.name: video.publication
facts.doc: An SFU publication started row bound to its publisher's seat. Claim: source.

facts.name: video.render_probe
facts.doc: A rendered-tile probe for a seat's camera tile. Claim: on_screen.

facts.name: video.send_window
facts.doc: One outbound camera layer's window counters for a seat. Claim: frames_encoded.

facts.name: video.source_lease
facts.doc: Source lease rows bound to the publisher's seat; a later lease_opened lifts the source_unauthorized exclusion. Claim: source.

facts.name: video.stats_failed
facts.doc: A stats collection failure for a seat. Claim: capture_error_name.

facts.name: video.tile
facts.doc: The rendered tile's surface state for a seat. Claim: tile_state.

facts.name: video.track_window
facts.doc: One inbound camera track's window counters for a seat, keyed by mid and publication. Claim: packets.

facts.name: video.transport
facts.doc: Cumulative SFU transport counters for a seat; never node liveness. Claim: dropped.

facts.name: video.viewer_pause
facts.doc: The viewer-bound pause/select trail for a seat: subscription started/paused/resumed/stopped rows, the SFU's select decision, and the client's recv_hidden_videos copy. All copy the viewer's request, so they are one witness.

symptoms.doc: The client lost its connection and did not recover within the recovery window.
A join attempt never got an admission decision, so the person waited on a screen that never resolved.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where client_session_id == '{attempt}' and kind == 'decision' and name in ('invite.resolve', 'admission.decided')
witnesses.doc: The decision that admits or refuses the attempt.

symptoms.doc: The Participant can't hear someone who is speaking.
The Participant's microphone is on but others can't hear them.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event == 'sdk.mic_state' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: When the seat's microphone was unmuted.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event == 'sfu.media.ingress' and media_kind == 'audio' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Whether voiced packets reached the SFU while it was unmuted.
The capture level, which attributes a silent ingress to a client hop.

symptoms.doc: A follower's whiteboard view jumped away from what the person they follow is looking at.

witnesses.doc: Every camera move, so a burst of automatic moves shows.

symptoms.doc: The Episode reached its time limit and ended. Expected, and it claims the client failures the end itself caused.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and name == 'sync.episode.ended'
witnesses.doc: The authoritative end Sync saw, with the reason the API stored. A time-limit end has the reason maximum_duration.

symptoms.doc: The Episode ended for an authoritative reason, but the client showed a failure end screen (connection lost or join failed) instead of the Episode-ended screen.
user_words: it said I lost connection when the class ended
the call ended with an error

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and name == 'sync.episode.ended'
witnesses.doc: The authoritative end and when it happened.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (name == 'client.call_ended' or (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type == 'call_ended'))
witnesses.doc: The end screen the seat's client chose.

symptoms.doc: The Participant joined but no media connected, so they neither hear nor are heard.
The call page crashed or rendered an error boundary.
An ended Episode's recording never became ready to watch.

witnesses.query: postgres: select state, updated_at from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Whether and how the job ended.

symptoms.doc: A Participant who left or dropped could not rejoin an Episode that was still active.
user_words: it won't let me back in

symptoms.doc: The Participant stopped sharing but others still see the share.
user_words: my screen is still being shared

A mute the trigger can't explain.

symptoms.doc: The publisher's camera never reached live with a bound publication.

witnesses.doc: The capture op's terminal: ok, expected(video.permission_denied) or error(video.*).
The camera state machine's path: capture_requested → captured → live/ended.
Pre-kernel camera failures on the same seat.
A camera-effects path failure.
Whether the participant actually asked for the camera.
A muted camera.
Whether the seat was connected.

Whether the surface froze or switched to frozen_frame.
Packets and decoder counters.
The freeze_ms and gap fields.
Whether the SFU kept forwarding.
A pause that stopped the flow.
A stats failure.
Whether the seat was connected.

The bitrate and layer rollups.
What the SFU forwarded and the plan it ran.
A pause forcing a low layer.
Downlink packet view.
The transport's estimate and drops.
The congestion cause.
